description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the BuzzPostShareAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It contains test methods to verify the behavior of API endpoints related to sharing posts, including fetching all shares and handling unimplemented methods like create, delete, and validation rules.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareAPITest
